name: accuse_bot
description: Call this IMMEDIATELY when the caller says or clearly implies that you are a bot, AI, robot or not a real person (for example: 'tum bot ho', 'aap AI ho', 'you're a bot', 'tu robot hai'). Do not call it when the caller is just chatting about bots or AI in general.

caller_phrase.description: The caller's exact words when they made the accusation
